headline: Exact franchise authority, actionable return continuity, and a truthfully deduplicated innovation queue shipped in one saturated arc.

items.title: Exact franchise authority
items.evidence: One shared franchiseId-first scope owns hydration epochs, background commits, and deterministic legacy fallback.

items.title: Franchise-scoped browser memory
items.evidence: Opening Contract, Return Digest, and trade-block ledgers fail closed across franchise switches.

items.title: Actionable return horizon
items.evidence: Return Digest opens and focuses the live Season target or explicitly reports its tab-only fallback.

items.title: Falsifiable game-loop contract
items.evidence: Public-safe plan/act/learn/return evidence boundaries plus exhaustive 27-choice Opening Contract coverage.

items.title: Second-order saturation
items.evidence: Semantic innovation dedup, exact-scope ownership guards, and truthful target fallback are implemented and tested.

followUps.title: External launch evidence
followUps.evidence: Bind the deployed revision, repair canonical health and edge headers in the owning host, establish real on-domain inbound delivery, reconcile lifecycle through Ark, then request founder approval.

blockers.title: Launch/SPARKED evidence gate
blockers.evidence: Staging 3/10, provenance 0/7, /_health 404, incomplete edge headers, no received-message receipt, no founder approval, and sibling-owned registry drift.

honestyLedger.title: No fabricated delivery evidence
honestyLedger.evidence: Brevo is credential-ready, but live probes found zero project inbound events and zero project-domain inbound webhooks.

honestyLedger.title: No fabricated visual inspection
honestyLedger.evidence: Automated 53-capture evidence is green; manual AI inspection is not claimed because both image bridges failed at the Windows DPAPI boundary.

honestyLedger.title: No fabricated player impact
honestyLedger.evidence: The game-loop contract claims implementation evidence only; no fun, pace, comprehension, retention, or causal lift is asserted.

diffStat.suite: Node 499/499; Playwright 20/20; responsive 53/53; Pages build, 51-module reachability, smoke, promise observability, sitemap, security, sanitization, and doctor green.
